title: Pairwise Calibrated Rewards for Pluralistic Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ensemble's ability to preserve diverse human preferences (pluralism) and avoid preference collapse by measuring the mean-squared calibration error (Brier score) against soft human preference labels, ensuring minority perspectives are not discounted. Policy diversity is additionally measured using Best-of-N sampling and Kendall-tau rank correlation across distinct reward models.
